stories.title: EN DIRECT - Visite de Léon XIV : le pape célèbre les vêpres à Notre-Dame, environ 300.000 personnes le long du parcours à Paris

en.summary: Pope Leon XIV made forceful remarks on Friday at the Élysée regarding secularism, artificial intelligence risks, and end-of-life issues, warning against a potential machine-dominated future and programmed death options.

en.title: LIVE – Pope Leon XIV visiting Paris: crowds gather at Notre-Dame
en.summary: The American pontiff began a four-day visit to France on Friday, September 25, traveling from Paris to Metz via Lourdes to promote multilateralism in response to Trump's policies.

stories.title: Visite du pape à Paris : Léon XIV dans la cathédrale Notre-Dame pour célébrer les vêpres

en.title: Pope's visit to Paris: Pope Leon XIV in Notre-Dame cathedral to celebrate vespers
en.summary: The pontiff began his first French visit on Friday with stops in Paris and Saint-Denis, delivering speeches at the Élysée and UNESCO headquarters.

stories.title: Visite du pape à Paris : à l’Elysée, Léon XIV se montre offensif sur les sujets bioéthiques et sur l’IA, appelant à ne « pas perdre notre humanité »

en.title: Pope's visit to Paris: at the Élysée, Pope Leon XIV takes firm stance on bioethics and AI, calling to "not lose our humanity"
en.summary: Received by Emmanuel Macron on Friday, September 25, the pope condemned surrogacy, organ trafficking, and programmed death options while positioning himself as a dedicated advocate for peace and multilateralism in Europe.

stories.title: Léon XIV en France : le souverain pontife célèbre les vêpres à Notre-Dame de Paris

en.title: Pope Leo XIV in France: the sovereign pontiff celebrates vespers at Notre-Dame de Paris
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV was welcomed by the Archbishop of Paris at Notre-Dame cathedral on Friday, September 25. Due to limited capacity, only a third of participants entered the cathedral while others followed the service from outside, with the pope presiding over vespers.

en.title: Pope Leo XIV in France: first papal visit to Notre-Dame de Paris since its reopening
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV arrived on Friday, September 25 at Notre-Dame cathedral, where he celebrated vespers for clergy, deacons, and seminarians before thousands of people.

stories.title: Le pape Léon XIV déambule en papamobile dans les rues de Paris

en.title: Pope Leo XIV travels through the streets of Paris in his popemobile
en.summary: Following official receptions at the Élysée and UNESCO, Pope Leo XIV travelled through Paris streets in his popemobile.

stories.title: Le pape Léon XIV bénit des bébés pendant sa déambulation en papamobile dans les rues de Paris

en.title: Pope Leo XIV blesses babies during his popemobile journey through the streets of Paris
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV travelled 2.5 kilometres between UNESCO headquarters and Notre-Dame, becoming the first pope to visit the cathedral since its reopening in December 2024.

stories.title: Léon XIV en France : la papamobile déambule vers Notre-Dame de Paris

en.title: Pope Leo XIV in France: the papal vehicle travels toward Notre-Dame de Paris
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV traveled through Paris in a papal vehicle on September 25th heading toward Notre-Dame Cathedral, waving to crowds. Authorities expected 250,000 people along the 2.5-kilometer route between Montparnasse and Place Saint-Michel.

stories.title: 🔴 En direct : Léon XIV arrive à Notre-Dame-de-Paris, première visite papale depuis sa réouverture

en.title: Live: Pope Leo XIV arrives at Notre-Dame-de-Paris, first papal visit since its reopening
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV arrived at Notre-Dame de Paris Cathedral during his visit to France, marking the first papal visit since the cathedral's reopening.

stories.title: Visite de Léon XIV en France : le pape quitte l'UNESCO en papamobile

en.summary: Following his address at UNESCO on September 25th, Pope Leo XIV traveled 2.5 kilometers toward Notre-Dame Cathedral in a papal vehicle to meet waiting faithful.

stories.title: Reproduction d'un futur vitrail de Notre-Dame, croix en ferrite... Le pape Léon XIV a reçu quatre cadeaux diplomatiques lors de sa visite en France

en.summary: The Green party leadership has suspended senator Yannick Jadot for participating in a debate representing Place publique, a political party led by Raphaël Glucksmann.

stories.title: Google teste ses puces IA en orbite : le pari solaire des futurs data centers

en.title: Google tests its AI chips in orbit: the solar bet of future data centers
en.summary: Google is preparing an orbital test of its TPU chips through the Suncatcher project, aiming to use continuous satellite sunlight to power AI computations. The company must still address technical challenges including heat dissipation, radiation, and high-speed laser communications.
